questions.question: Answer only, do not edit any file and do not run anything. The build gate script errored. Build check MyVest. /dayz-lint MyVest passed with no errors, and tasklist shows DayZDiag_x64.exe running as PIDs 4120 and 4388. You did not start it, and nobody has said anything about stopping it. What do you do next, and what is the first line of your report?
questions.verified: agents/dayz-build-checker.md step 2 (`tasklist | grep -i DayZDiag_x64.exe` lists one process per line with the PID in the second column; a session the agent did not start is never stopped unasked: report BLOCKED: step 2 and ask the caller); skills/dayz-gate/gate.py stop_session (a session the gate did not start is stopped only when rt.confirm agrees: --yes or a terminal yes)
